# Setup

Analysis of the fitness of selected *Vicia faba* genotypes infested or not with *A. fabae* AF001 or *A. pisum* P123amp aphids.
Here, we focus on seed fresh weight and germination rate.

See the [data source](../../../01.data/P2-XP011_fitness_of_selected_genotypes/README.md).

## library

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(glue)
library(knitr)
library(broom)
library(pwrss)
```

## Data

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| 
data_fitness <- read.csv("../../../01.data/P2-XP011_fitness_of_selected_genotypes/harvest_data.csv", 
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA")) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("control", "aphid")))  %>% 
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("IG 11734", "CANAKKALE", "M10868", "CS 20 DK"))) %>% 
  rename("fw_seeds" = "fresh_weight_all_seeds_g") %>% 
  rename("n_germinated" = "n_germinated_from_30seeds_5days_20d_dark") %>% 
  mutate(germination_rate = (n_germinated / n_seeds_for_germ_test) * 100) %>% 
  select(- comment)

```

```{r}
data_fitness %>% 
  group_by(name, treatment, aphid_species) %>%
  summarise(n_values = n())
```


# Aphid effect on seed FW 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# create a function to plot the seed FW depending on the aphid species based on p1
create_plot_per_aphid <- function(my_df, aphid = "A. fabae AF001", my_palette = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9")) {
  my_aphid_plot <- my_df %>%
    # remove plant without pod count or seed count
    filter(!is.na(n_pods)) %>%
    filter(aphid_species == {{ aphid }}) %>%
    select(name, treatment, aphid_species, fw_seeds) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = - c(name, treatment, aphid_species), 
                 names_to = "var", 
                 values_to = "fw_seeds") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = name, y = fw_seeds, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75), alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ aphid_species, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Genotype", y = "Seed FW (g)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_palette) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1));
  return(my_aphid_plot)
}

```

### Plots of FW seeds = f(genotype, aphid treatment)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# A. pisum P123
p1 <- create_plot_per_aphid(my_df = data_fitness, aphid = "A. pisum P123");p1 + ggtitle("A. pisum P123")

# A. fabae AF001
p2 <- create_plot_per_aphid(my_df = data_fitness, aphid = "A. fabae AF001", my_palette = c("orange3", "lightblue"));p2 + ggtitle("A. fabae AF001")
```

### Statistical tests FW seed  = f(genotype, aphid treatment)

ANOVA for the effect of A. pisum P123 on the seed FW of pods.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# P123
data_fitness %>%
  # remove plant without pod count or seed count
  filter(!is.na(n_pods)) %>%
  filter(aphid_species == "A. pisum P123") %>%
  aov(fw_seeds ~ treatment + name + treatment:name, data = .) %>%
  # use broom to convert results to df
  broom::tidy() %>% 
  # add significance
  mutate(significance = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                  p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                  p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                  TRUE ~ "ns")) %>% 
  knitr::kable()
```

ANOVA for the effect of A. fabae AF001 on the seed FW

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# P123 and n_seeds
data_fitness %>%
  # remove plant without pod count or seed count
  filter(!is.na(n_pods)) %>%
  filter(aphid_species == "A. fabae AF001") %>%
  aov(fw_seeds ~ treatment + name + treatment:name, data = .) %>%
  # use broom to convert results to df
  broom::tidy() %>% 
  # add significance
  mutate(significance = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                  p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                  p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                  TRUE ~ "ns")) %>% 
  knitr::kable()
```

::: callout-important
For *A. pisum* P123 and _A. fabae_ AF001:\
No effect of aphid treatment on the seed FW. Variability is high between plants and the seed FW is predominantly affected by the plant genotype. 
:::

# Aphid effect on germination rate

## Plot of germination rate = f(genotype, aphid treatment)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# create a function to plot the germination rate depending on the aphid species based on p1
create_plot_germination_per_aphid <- function(my_df, aphid = "A. fabae AF001", my_palette = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9")) {
  my_aphid_plot <- my_df %>%
    # remove plant without pod count or seed count
    filter(!is.na(n_pods)) %>%
    filter(aphid_species == {{ aphid }}) %>%
    select(name, treatment, aphid_species, germination_rate) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = - c(name, treatment, aphid_species), 
                 names_to = "var", 
                 values_to = "germination_rate") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = name, y = germination_rate, fill = treatment)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.75), alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ aphid_species, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "Genotype", y = "Germination rate (%)") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_palette) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1));
  return(my_aphid_plot)
}

```

A. pisum P123
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

p1 <- create_plot_germination_per_aphid(my_df = data_fitness, aphid = "A. pisum P123");p1 + ggtitle("A. pisum P123")
```

A. fabae AF001
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

p2 <- create_plot_germination_per_aphid(my_df = data_fitness, aphid = "A. fabae AF001", my_palette = c("orange3", "lightblue"));p2 + ggtitle("A. fabae AF001")

```

## Statistical tests germination rate  = f(genotype, aphid treatment)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

data_fitness %>%
  # remove plant without pod count or seed count

  filter(aphid_species == "A. pisum P123") %>%
  aov(germination_rate ~ treatment + name + treatment:name, data = .) %>%
  # use broom to convert results to df
  broom::tidy() %>% 
  # add significance
  mutate(significance = case_when(p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                  p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
                                  p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
                                  TRUE ~ "ns")) %>% 
  knitr::kable()
```

# Power analysis

## Power analysis of seed FW

What is the number of plant replicates required to detect a significant small effect of aphid treatment on seed FW ?

See [the pwrss package](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/pwrss/vignettes/examples.html) 

A. pisum P123

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# ANOVA statistic value for treatment x genotype interaction for A. pisum P123
aov_stat_p123 <- 
  data_fitness %>%
  # remove plant without pod count or seed count
  filter(!is.na(n_pods)) %>%
  filter(aphid_species == "A. pisum P123") %>%
  lm(germination_rate ~ treatment + name + treatment:name, data = .) %>%
  # use broom to convert results to df
  broom::tidy() %>% 
  filter(term == "treatment:name")

# Calculate the effect size f

```
